include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# tree.com is all Rust (tree-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/tree-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# tree.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/tree-rust/src/tree/tree.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(tree_res OBJECT tree.rc)
target_compile_definitions(tree_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(tree_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(TREE_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/conutils/libconutils.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/conutils/libconutils_rust.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/pseh/libpseh.a)
if(ARCH STREQUAL "i386")
    list(APPEND TREE_REUSED ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/libchkstk.a)
endif()
if(ARCH STREQUAL "arm64")
    list(APPEND TREE_REUSED ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/libchkstk.a)
endif()
add_cargo_module(tree tree-cargo tree.com
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE tree-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS tree_res ${TREE_REUSED})
